items.detail: PatentTerminalParseError: Largan Family 78617163 item 1; paragraphs 48-62 and FIGS. 1-7 publish camera module 1 with one first-assembly lens, three second-assembly lenses, one powered folding component, mechanical DH/D/L values and FOV=18.6 degrees. The exact source publishes no ordered optical radius, spacing, material, refractive-index/dispersion, conic, asphere, aperture-stop or system focal/F-number/image-height prescription. The source expressly says the partial lens contours do not restrict lens shape. FOV and lens-count values therefore remain architecture metadata and do not create a prescription. Claims 1-20, including independent camera-module claims 1/10 and dependent electronic-device claim 20, add no separate ordered prescription. No value is derived, measured from drawings, transcribed from raster, or borrowed from prior publication US-20220394159-A1, Taiwan priority 110120061, another family or a shared layout
